Background

Jon Ossoff has represented Georgia in the U.S. Senate since 2021 and won a second term on November 3, 2026. A former investigative journalist, he is the youngest sitting Democratic senator.

Outlook

Prediction markets rank him first, near 27 percent, and he won the Crooked Con activist straw poll with 38 percent. But he has said repeatedly that he is not running and pledged at an October debate to serve his full six-year term. We take the pledge seriously and hold him well below his market price, but a swing-state winner this popular with the party stays on the board until the field is set.
